scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC- Haryana
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Must belong to the Scheduled Caste community
Must be between 18 and 45 years old
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 (with 50% of beneficiaries up to ₹1,50,000)
Must be a student pursuing regular full‑time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad
Loan can be availed only once at either Diploma/Graduation or Post‑Graduation level (integrated courses allowed)
Applicants who secured admission before 1‑Dec‑2009 are eligible only if they have not received an educational loan from any other institution
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10 lakh for studies in India and up to ₹30 lakh for studies abroad, with repayment over 5 years in quarterly installments.
